#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -u
task_root=/home/rich/.codex/worktrees/topindex-numeric-5611/Project-Copperfin
cd "$task_root" || exit 1
task_raw=build/topindex-native
export TMPDIR="$task_root/build/topindex-tmp"
task_targets=(test_prg_engine_topindex_numeric test_prg_engine_listitemid_numeric test_prg_engine_listindex_numeric
 test_prg_engine_list_index_numeric test_prg_engine_listitem_numeric
 test_prg_engine_itemidtoindex_numeric test_prg_engine_indextoitemid_numeric
 test_prg_engine_selectedid_numeric test_prg_engine_selected_index_numeric
 test_prg_engine_itemdata_index_numeric test_prg_engine_getcolor_default_numeric
 test_prg_engine_numeric_behavior test_prg_engine_int64_exact_expression
 test_prg_engine_runtime_surface_itemid_selectors test_prg_engine_runtime_surface_functions)
task_regex='^(test_prg_engine_(topindex_numeric|listitemid_numeric|listindex_numeric|list_index_numeric|listitem_numeric|itemidtoindex_numeric|indextoitemid_numeric|selectedid_numeric|selected_index_numeric|itemdata_index_numeric|getcolor_default_numeric)(_(copperfin|vfp9)_session[12])?|test_prg_engine_numeric_behavior|test_prg_engine_int64_exact_expression|test_native_test_isolation_contract|test_prg_engine_runtime_surface_itemid_selectors|test_prg_engine_runtime_surface_functions)$'
sha256sum -c "$task_raw/frozen.sha256" "$task_raw/base-production.sha256" "$task_raw/neighbors.sha256" > "$task_raw/frozen-preflight.log" || exit 2
nice -n 10 ionice -c 2 -n 7 g++ -std=c++20 -Iinclude -Itests -Isrc -fsyntax-only tests/test_prg_engine_topindex_numeric.cpp > "$task_raw/syntax.log" 2>&1
task_status=$?
printf '%s\n' "$task_status" > "$task_raw/syntax.status"
test "$task_status" -eq 0 || exit "$task_status"
for task_compiler in gcc clang; do
 task_build="build/topindex-$task_compiler"
 task_args=(-DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DCOPPERFIN_BUILD_TESTS=ON)
 if test "$task_compiler" = gcc; then
  task_args+=(-DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_DEBUG='-O0 -g0')
  unset ASAN_OPTIONS UBSAN_OPTIONS
 else
  task_args+=(-DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=clang -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=clang++
   -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_DEBUG='-O1 -g0 -fsanitize=address,undefined,float-cast-overflow -fno-omit-frame-pointer')
  export ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0:halt_on_error=1
  export UBSAN_OPTIONS=halt_on_error=1:print_stacktrace=1
 fi
 nice -n 10 ionice -c 2 -n 7 cmake -S . -B "$task_build" -G Ninja "${task_args[@]}" > "$task_raw/configure-$task_compiler.log" 2>&1
 task_status=$?
 printf '%s\n' "$task_status" > "$task_raw/configure-$task_compiler.status"
 test "$task_status" -eq 0 || exit "$task_status"
 nice -n 10 ionice -c 2 -n 7 cmake --build "$task_build" -j 1 --target "${task_targets[@]}" > "$task_raw/compile-$task_compiler.log" 2>&1
 task_status=$?
 printf '%s\n' "$task_status" > "$task_raw/compile-$task_compiler.status"
 test "$task_status" -eq 0 || exit "$task_status"
 sha256sum -c "$task_raw/frozen.sha256" "$task_raw/base-production.sha256" "$task_raw/neighbors.sha256" > "$task_raw/frozen-before-$task_compiler.log" || exit 2
 nice -n 10 ionice -c 2 -n 7 ctest --test-dir "$task_build" -V --output-on-failure --timeout 600 -j 1 -R "$task_regex" > "$task_raw/original-$task_compiler.log" 2>&1
 task_status=$?
 printf '%s\n' "$task_status" > "$task_raw/original-$task_compiler.status"
 date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' > "$task_raw/original-$task_compiler.completed-at"
 sha256sum -c "$task_raw/frozen.sha256" "$task_raw/base-production.sha256" "$task_raw/neighbors.sha256" > "$task_raw/frozen-after-$task_compiler.log" || exit 2
 sha256sum "$task_raw/original-$task_compiler.log" > "$task_raw/original-$task_compiler.log.sha256"
 # Preserve actual baseline failures; NEVER claim they are acceptance.
 test "$task_status" -eq 0 || test "$task_status" -eq 8 || exit "$task_status"
done
